entries.msgstr:
Determines the degree of additional processing for thin lines and contours of game objects. Minimizes the aliasing effect.

• High—FXAA
• Maximum—Temporal Supersampling Antialiasing (TSSAA)

Enable or disable automatic adjustment of 3D render resolution depending on the video card load.

Enabling this parameter can improve game performance. The render resolution in the Garage always remains the same.

Determines the display quality of sparks from ricochets, explosions, smoke, and other visual effects.

Reducing the value of this parameter can improve game performance.
Determines the display distance of relief features, buildings, enemy vehicles, and other game objects.
Determines the density of grass displayed in Arcade and Sniper modes.

Enables a more detailed and realistic processing of object destruction on maps.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.
The setting will be applied in the next battle, if it is disabled in the current battle.
Enables enhanced visual effects. Disabling this option reverts to standard effects, which may improve game performance.
The setting will be applied in the next battle, if it is disabled in the current battle.

Accuracy of setting sun rays, lighting, and optical effects.

Increasing the value of this parameter considerably increases load on video card.
Determines the quality of motion blur effect of an image when a vehicle moves and camera rotates.

Determines the degree of additional processing for thin lines and contours of game objects. Minimizes aliasing effect.

• Low—MSAA 2x
• Medium—MSAA 4x
• High—MSAA 8x
Determines the number of displayed objects and their quality.

Determines the quality of post-processing visual effects: heat shimmer and shockwave effects, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain, etc.

Reducing the value of this parameter can improve game performance.

Improved: allows for maximum image quality.

Simplified: allows for maximum performance by simplifying or disabling some visual effects.
Changes to this parameter will take effect after restarting the game.

Determines how foliage for nearby trees and bushes is displayed.

Disabling this parameter displays the foliage of nearby trees and bushes as completely invisible, which can improve game performance.

Determines the quality of dynamic shadow processing over the entire draw distance.

Reducing the value of this parameter can considerably improve game performance.

Determines the display quality of sparks from ricochets, explosions, smoke, and other realistic effects in Sniper mode.

Reducing the value of this parameter can improve the game performance.

Displays grass in Sniper mode.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.

Increases the quality of terrain within a radius of 50 meters from your vehicle in Sniper mode. Available only with the Terrain Tessellation option enabled.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.
Determines the draw quality of trees, bushes, and grass.

Determines the draw quality of map relief features.

Use the minimum landscape quality only in the case of low computer performance.

Reducing the value of this parameter can cause desynchronization of landscape display between client and server.
Applying the specified parameter may take some time.

A hardware-accelerated process of adding new triangles to the polygon mesh to increase the mesh details.

This function only works with:
• Improved Graphics
• High, Maximum, or Ultra Terrain Quality
• DirectX 11 installed.

The settings changes are unavailable with versions older than DirectX 11.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.

Quality of surfaces of game objects, especially under close examination.

Reducing the value of this parameter can improve game performance.
Applying the specified parameter may take some time.

Determines the quality of physics simulations for broken and operational tracks, as well as the track details.

Reducing or disabling this parameter can improve game performance.

Displays ground, snow, and water splashes behind the tracks and wheels.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.

Displays track and wheel traces on the ground.

Unavailable with Simplified Graphics and Low Decal Quality.

Adjusts the visibility of effects and 3D attachments near the center of the screen to reduce visual obstruction while aiming. 3D attachment visibility is only adjusted in Sniper mode.

Lower values make effects and 3D attachments more transparent for increased aiming clarity
Determines the draw quality of water surfaces.

If active, the Flashlight highlights only weak target armor.

Armor with a high penetration chance is highlighted in solid green, while armor with a moderate penetration chance is semi-transparent green. The colors may be different in colorblind mode.

If active, the Flashlight highlights only strong target armor.

Armor with a low to zero penetration chance is highlighted in solid red, while armor with a moderate penetration chance is semi-transparent red. The colors may be different in colorblind mode.

If active, the Flashlight highlights all target armor.

Armor with a low to zero penetration chance is highlighted in red, armor with a high penetration chance is green, and armor with a moderate penetration chance is yellow. The colors may be different in colorblind mode.
When scrolling the mouse wheel and reaching a certain zoom value, the reticle will switch to the "top view" or the "trajectory view".
Show/hide the indicators that display whether the selected shell will reach the aiming point. They also show the shell flight time.
Show/hide the indicator that displays the zoom level of the artillery aiming camera.
In standard camera controls mode, the camera moves up, down, left, and right. In alternative camera controls mode, the camera moves forward, backward, and around the SPG position.

Determines optimum image quality for your computer.

This may take some time.
Show location markers on the map
Show base markers in Random Battles
Censor offensive words in chat messages
Receive messages only from the Contact list
Remember position of camera and channel windows
Remember position of camera and other windows
Accept invitations only from friends in the Garage
Accept invitations to Platoon in battle
Select one of the image adjustment options
When aiming at the enemy vehicle, its entire contour is outlined, including applied non-armor elements that shells cannot interact with.
When aiming at the enemy vehicle, part of its contour is outlined, including only armor elements that shells can interact with.
Displaying shell obstacles when aiming at the enemy vehicle.

Dynamic FoV allows you to set the minimum and maximum view angle in Arcade aim.

Maximum angle is used when the camera is zoomed away from the vehicle.

Minimum angle is used when zoomed in to the vehicle.

Determines game scene quality and details.

3D render resolution in a battle can be changed by using [RShift +] and [RShift -]. Does not influence the interface.

Reducing this parameter can improve game performance for computers with a low-performance video card.

The three most recent events
are displayed in battle
Hiding the map border may result in disorientation in battle.

Enabling this setting is not recommended
for displays with a low resolution
A block for detailed damage information. Shows complete information about your effectiveness in battle.

Visibility range of the game camera.

95° is the normal FoV (field of view). The smaller the FoV, the closer objects appear, while peripheral view is reduced. 

Does not influence game performance.
Tips on the battle loading screen
Display stats upon hovering over a slot in the Garage
Display of customization elements in battle
Display vehicles of Platoon members in the Garage
Show previous battle results in chat
Enable optics effect in Sniper mode
Show the repair time for damaged modules
Display the speedometer of wheeled vehicles
Garage camera animation when moving the mouse cursor
Garage camera rotation when idle for
Enable automatic hull lock in Sniper mode
Display server selection upon game launch
Enable beginner tips in Random Battles
Enable beginner tips on the battle loading screen
Show moment your vehicle was destroyed (detailed)
Show enemy vehicle that destroyed your vehicle
Show moment your vehicle was destroyed (short)
Display of the area SPGs will hit
Display notifications when not causing damage
Display your applied Customizable Dog Tag
Show the Dog Tag of the player who destroyed you
Display arc of fire for the SPG
Show vehicle HP on the minimap
Show vehicle HP in team panels
Show vehicle markers on Battle Score Panel
Display Dog Tags of enemies you destroy
Restrict toggling the Sniper mode to the Shift key
Play on maps with Random Events
Move the slider until the background and logo reach the same brightness. Close your eyes partially or move away from your monitor, to make the image details hardly visible.

Allows for the brightness to be adjusted to the optimal value. This option aims to
compensate for the effects from video card drivers and display
settings that affect the game's visual quality.

Determines the general quality of the image. Determines the parameters of the Details tab.

Reducing the graphics quality can:
• Improve game performance
• Cause desynchronization of the landscape's display between client and server.

Use the minimum graphics quality only in the case of low computer performance.

Standard Client—full game without maximum-quality textures.

HD Client—full game including maximum-quality textures. Requires more hard drive space than the Standard Client.

HD Client—full game including maximum-quality textures. Requires more hard drive space than the Standard Client.

Standard Client (SD)—full game without maximum-quality textures.
Maximum (SD) and Ultra (SD) graphics quality do not provide the maximum value of the Texture Quality parameter. To set the maximum graphics quality, switch to HD Client in the game launcher.

When this setting is enabled, web content will be rendered using GPU instead of CPU.

Disable it if you experience issues with rendering the contents of some windows.

The change will be applied upon game restart.

Feature is undergoing testing;
it does not influence game performance.

Automatic scaling of interface elements
when maximizing game screen/window.
Automatic scaling of interface elements when maximizing game screen/window.
Feature is undergoing testing; it does not influence game performance.

Automatic scaling of interface elements
when maximizing game screen/window.
Automatic scaling of interface elements when maximizing game screen/window.
Adaptation of the color palette for people with color vision deficiency.
Enable/disable voice chat in Dynamic Platoons
Gradual appearance of hidden interface elements in the Garage

When this setting is enabled, a tier will be displayed above the vehicle.

In Steel Hunter, the current upgrade level will be displayed.
Select the primary display for the game.

Display refresh rate in the game.

Mismatch with display refresh rate can cause a blinking screen effect.

Does not influence game performance.

Horizontal and vertical screen resolution in a fullscreen mode. Higher resolution improves image quality. Mismatch of set resolution in a fullscreen mode with current display resolution can distort the image.

Increasing this parameter increases load on video card and can reduce game performance.

Load on video card can be reduced by setting 3D render resolution.
Reset the beginner tip history to receive tips which were already shown to you again.
Switch between full-screen, windowed, and windowed (borderless) game modes. The windowed game mode will reduce game performance.

Displays a selection of visually striking tanks during the pre-battle countdown.

Disabling this parameter can improve game performance.
If the setting is disabled for the current battle, it will be enabled for the next one.
Determines degree of additional processing of thin lines and contours of game objects. Minimizes aliasing effect. Contours of objects look more natural.
Voice messages depend on a vehicle's nation and the commander's gender
Male voice in the game client's language
Select one of variants for the Sound Detection activation sound. To use your own sound, rename your .mp3 file to soundExploring and move it to the res/audioww folder.
Enhances low frequencies in-game with the master volume remaining the same. The mode implementation may differ depending on the selected sound system (speakers, headphones, or laptop).
Select one of variants for the Sixth Sense activation sound. To use your own sound, rename your .mp3 file to sixthSense and move it to the res/audioww folder.
Disabling game sound effects may improve the overall game performance. You will have to restart the game client for the changes to apply.
Levels out volume differences, reduces sharp sounds, and minimizes low frequencies in-game, providing a comfortable and soft sound environment for late-night gaming.
Enabling this feature may impact performance.

Controls the quality of sound physics.

Simulates how sound bends around obstacles and passes through map surfaces.

Uses map geometry to generate early reflections of tank sounds bouncing off nearby objects.

Determines the optimum sound physics quality for your computer.

This may take some time.
Custom sound. Move the sixthSense.mp3 file to the res/audioww folder.
Adjusts the in-game sound for external paired full-range speakers (2.0) or paired high frequency speakers + one low frequency speaker (2.1).
Adjusts the positioning of in-game sound for the external speakers and subwoofer in the multichannel 5.1 system.
Adjusts the positioning of in-game sound for the external speakers and subwoofer in the multichannel 7.1 system.
Automatically determines the audio configuration settings, specified in the operating system.
Adjusts the in-game sound for headphones.
Uses the positioning principle of the 2.0/2.1 Sound System preset but adjusts the in-game sound for playback on small laptop speakers at the highest quality possible.
Reducing the sound quality may improve the overall game performance on low-end computers. Enabling this mode significantly reduces the number of sounds processed simultaneously.
Sound test on right/left rear speakers.
Sound test on the central speaker.
Sound test on right/left front speakers.
In the 2.0/2.1 system, a subwoofer presents an optional device. It cannot be tested without speakers.
Sound test on right/left side speakers.
Decreases tearing on frame change (available only with vertical synchronization enabled).

Synchronization of frame rate with display refresh rate.

60 frames per second is the frame rate limit. This option may help correct a shaking image effect or image delay at the bottom of the screen relative to the top.
Horizontal and vertical screen resolution of the game client window. When switching to fullscreen mode, the setting changes to "Screen Resolution".
